text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After finishing our errand. Believe said she was going to stop
by the home improvement store in the mall, so I offered to join her."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...We used quite a bit of the mortar from the school
to repair the building's walls, so...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I'm just going to buy more to make up for it.
Please go on ahead back.
choice_data_list: At least let me carry your bags!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
......
If that's what you say, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah!
Curren-senpai, over there..."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh. I already want to talk.
choice_data_list: ...? What in the world is going on?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I don't know.
However...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It's been happening a lot lately.
It feels like... everyone's avoiding me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hearing that made me remember how Believe had once turned down a friend's invitation to prioritize work—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"For better or worse, she never makes excuses.
Could that be leading to misunderstandings, I wonder...?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Excuse me.
I'll take my leave now.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Understood.
Tomorrow... yes. Excuse me.
choice_data_list: What was that phone call about?
What was that phone call about?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Curren-san wants you to come to a specified place tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Between what happened earlier and just general concern over whether Believe could get along with her friends, before I knew it, I had offered to accompany them.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It seems the location is... here.
...A campsite? Why would—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Bang! Bang, bang!!)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Wah... What is it?

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
"Believe-san! Thanks as alwaaays!!"
"Believe-senpai! Thanks a hundred miles!!"
"Believe-san, thank you as always, yes."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry for calling you out so suddenly!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ta-da-da-daaa! Today, I'd like to hold an "Appreciation Party for Believe-san"～. Peace.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Gratitude...? What for?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Because you're always working so hard for everyone's sake, aren't you, Believe-san?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fixing the pizza oven, patching up the school walls...
She's always helping everyone with her handiwork.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
In that case, you definitely deserve
a reward every now and then, right?♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
And here's my contribution!
It's my personal favorite, ultimate salad dressing!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Once you put it on, that's it! That's really it!
The probability of Believe-senpai getting hooked is 120 mph!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
From Chan, here is this:
a Chan doll.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
One for every household. No, one for every person.
Please welcome a Chan-me into your heart, too.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
......Huh.
It's remarkably well made.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
How does it taste? I tailored it to your tastes
with a more traditional Japanese seasoning.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ......I think that sounds good.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yay, that's great!
...Ehehe. Actually, the thing is...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: We baked this in the pizza oven that Believe-san fixed for us!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ You're all smiles, Trainer.
Did something good happen?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems I had been worrying too much about Believe's friendships. Once again, I bowed my head to Curren Chan.
choice_data_list: Thank you! For throwing such a wonderful party!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha. I'm not the one who deserves thanks today, you know♪
—And you know that better than anyone, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way home. Despite being congratulated by her friends, I walked alongside Believe, who wore a somewhat contemplative expression.
choice_data_list: We sure got a lot of sweets.
We got so many sweets, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way home. Despite being congratulated by her friends, I walked alongside Believe, who wore a somewhat contemplative expression.
choice_data_list: We sure got a lot of sweets.
We got so many sweets, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I only did my job.
My work. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ......I was surprised.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
So much...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...There's quite a lot, so I think I'll share them.
Like with Durandal-san, and Light O-san—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
To Miss Lala, and to the grandpas and grandmas
who always take such good care of me, too.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Since I can't eat it all.
